quotes.name: Kenji Tanaka
quotes.quote: I'm not sure. I know the Bay Pure Land Buddhist Temple is a place of peace for our community, but I haven't seen their crisis response efforts in action myself, so I can't say what specifically brought those people in.

quotes.name: Eunice Marston
quotes.quote: It is a balance we have to maintain. We had those 72 people come to us for crisis support, and then we had 237 for Epiphany. As a faith leader, you just keep your focus on the people and their needs, whether that means providing emergency aid or coming together for a holy day. It's all part of the same work.

quotes.name: Manny Ellen
quotes.quote: I've joined the congregation there. I was just over at the church recently when the lunch program was wrapping up; I saw the volunteers stacking chairs while some of the seniors stayed behind to finish their coffee.
